symptom: Mode-2/align-0 narration (thefog.p2s: 'heavy fog had settled / over the deserted / streets.') renders with each line centered on a point well LEFT of screen-center. The longest line (line 1, 21-23 glyphs) is centered at PS2-x≈101 vs the correct 160, so its left edge sits at x≈9 and clips/touches the left screen border. Shorter lines drift back toward center (line 3 center≈167). Patch 23 (+8 origin / li a0,8) did not fix it and if anything is irrelevant to the visible stagger.
root_cause: Narration uses a TWO-PEN origin (0x1cc + 0x1ce). For align==0 narration (the live case, s0+0x2a7==0), per-line horizontal CENTERING is applied by subtracting a count-proportional half-width from the pen. Patch 23 replaced the pristine 'subu a0,a0,a1' (a1 = count*12) at 0x308328 with 'li a0,8', which only neutralizes the 0x1cc pen — it forces 0x1cc to the constant 8. But the visible per-line stagger (−5.08 px/char, i.e. ~half a glyph advance per character) is driven by the OTHER pen, 0x1ce, which still receives a count-proportional centering offset that Patch 23 never touched. With 0x1cc pinned to a tiny constant (8) instead of a proper box-left-minus-halfwidth, the combined origin = 8 + (0x1ce count-centering) lands the line center ~59px left of true center for the longest line. The base/anchor that should hold the box center (~160) is gone: short lines happen to land near center, long lines overshoot left and clip. Patch 23 is the v121-class failure — a byte-correct edit on the wrong contributor (it pinned 0x1cc when the centering that actually positions the line lives on 0x1ce, and it discarded the count*12 right-anchor that the pristine code used to keep the box centered).

fix_hypothesis: Stop patching the 0x1cc pen at 0x308328. The real per-line centering for narration must put each line's center at the box center: origin_x = box_left + (box_width_px - line_width_px)/2, where line_width_px is the SUM of proportional ADV[g] for the line (not count*const). Recommended for the architect: (a) REVERT Patch 23 so 0x308328 restores the pristine right-anchor 'subu a0,a0,a1', then (b) make the count-proportional term use the true proportional line pixel width (accumulate ADV[g] like the Patch-14 0x1ce pen does) and a half-width (÷2) subtraction from a correct box-left origin — i.e. add a cave at the align-dispatch that computes -(line_px_width/2) and adds it to the SAME pen that the draw-X actually reads as the anchor (the 0x1cc pen feeding 0x309774), instead of the constant 8. Concretely: replace the count*12 (≈ full monospace width, and on the wrong pen) with sum(ADV)/2 applied to 0x1cc, and verify box_left (currently effectively ~8) equals the narration window's true left so center lands at 160. Validate by re-reading thefog.p2s-equivalent after rebuild: line1 center should move from 101 to ~160 and left edge from 9 to ~67. Do NOT touch the 0x1ce advance pen (proportional spacing is correct); the bug is the origin/anchor, not the per-glyph advance.
